slides.h: ANIMALS REVIEWED [[DATING APPS]]. THE CAT SWIPED {{ONCE}}.
slides.tease: **The dog matched with everyone.** The cat's review closes the case.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.title: 9,000 SOULMATES
slides.body: Swiped right on everyone. Every match is the one. Meeting all of them at the park at 3. Bring your friends.

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.title: The matches come to me
slides.body: Stood on a statue looking magnificent. Three humans pointed. That is three matches and I did not lift a wing.

slides.name: The Owl
slides.title: Methodologically unsound
slides.body: Reviewed 40 profiles for grammar. Rejected all 40. Matched with nobody and logged it as a successful study.

slides.name: The Raccoon
slides.title: Excellent marketplace
slides.body: Bio says visionary. Sold my first match a candle subscription by message two. This app pays for itself.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.title: One swipe was plenty
slides.body: Every third photo is a human holding a fish. I live with a human. I know what the fish means. It means nothing.
Tag the friend whose bio says fluent in sarcasm.
